description: #AI Trash# Fires Fabric API's disconnect event when Carpet fake players log out, so map mods stop showing them online forever. Fixes gnembon/fabric-carpet#1983

mods.name: Carpet Fake Player Events
mods.description: Makes Carpet fake players fire Fabric API's disconnect event when they log out, so map and player-tracking mods stop showing them forever.

releases.notes:
假人注销时补发 Fabric API 的 disconnect 事件，让 BlueMap 等模组不再把假人永远显示为在线。
*Fires Fabric API's disconnect event when Carpet fake players log out, so mods like BlueMap stop showing them online forever.*

修复 [gnembon/fabric-carpet#1983](https://github.com/gnembon/fabric-carpet/issues/1983)。
*Fixes [gnembon/fabric-carpet#1983](https://github.com/gnembon/fabric-carpet/issues/1983).*

**依赖 / Requires:** Minecraft ≥ 26.2 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 · Carpet ≥ 26.2 · Fabric API

**规则 / Rule:** `fakePlayerDisconnectEvents` (`boolean`, 默认 / default `true`)
